questions.q: Does responding to reviews improve local SEO?
questions.a: Yes, Google's own Business Profile documentation says that actively managing and responding to reviews shows your business is engaged, which can help local rankings. Consistent replies across all your locations, especially to negative reviews, signal active engagement. Responsiveness also encourages more guests to leave reviews, which adds to your visibility.

questions.q: How quickly should a restaurant respond to online reviews?
questions.a: Respond as fast as you can, especially to negative reviews. An unhappy guest is often still open to a resolution right after posting, and a reply days later with a template usually comes too late. Fast, personal replies can prevent churn and bring that guest back.

questions.q: Are review response templates good enough?
questions.a: Generic templates tend to fall flat because guests can spot them instantly and don't feel heard. They also often miss the actual issue, so future readers learn nothing about how you handled it. Replies that match the review's tone, mention the specific problem and stay on-brand work much better.

questions.q: Should I use AI to reply to customer reviews?
questions.a: AI is a practical way to reply to every review across many locations, as long as it's trained on your brand voice. Let it handle positive and neutral reviews and the first acknowledgment of negative ones, then escalate high-risk reviews to a person with context. That keeps replies fast without losing the human touch.

questions.q: Which metrics show whether my review response strategy is working?
questions.a: Beyond review volume and star ratings, track time to first response, how many reviewers update their review after your reply, recurring keywords in negative reviews and how often issues get escalated. These show whether your replies are improving the guest experience. Review them by location to spot where help is needed.

questions.q: How does Momos help with review response?
questions.a: Momos responds to every review across every location and lets you train its AI to match your brand voice. Critical issues are escalated automatically for a person to resolve. You can also track performance and sentiment trends for each location and report on the return from your response strategy.
